title: LLV-G125GP: growing integer precision sharpens both time and classical space

claims.statement: For every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, put n = ceil(log2 N). The single LLV-G125GP configuration specified in proof.md Section 0, including its finite exhaustive branch and literal counters, recovers the entire secret from independent ideal copies with unconditional probability at least 1 - 2^-8. On EVERY execution branch its charged sequential work is O(2^((1/8)sqrt(n) log2(n) + (1/2)sqrt(n) + 2 n^(7/16))), with an absolute outside constant and exact growth index 1/2. On the main branch a = ceil(n^(1/8)), P_prec = ceil(n^(1/16)), H_prec = bit_length(a^P_prec - 1), B_src = floor(floor(sqrt(n))/2) - a - 100 ceil(log2 n), m = floor(P_prec B_src/H_prec), kappa = ceil(log2(m+a)) + 3, and lambda = ceil((n + m kappa)/(m(a-1))). All roots, powers and divisions use the exact integer algorithms in the proof. All searches, serial lookup and list exclusion, source and extraction work, circuit generation, addressing, measurements, resets, failed work, discarded copies and cleanup are charged. This holds jointly with the other four claims for the same configuration.

For the same LLV-G125GP configuration, every N and s, and the same independent-ideal-copy promise, peak classical workspace on EVERY branch is O(2^((1/4)n^(3/8) log2(n) + 3 n^(5/16))) bits. The outside constant is absolute and the exact envelope has growth index 3/8. Tables, residue arrays, verified tuple lists, recursion records, schedules, counters, caps, extraction, decoders and growing-precision arithmetic are included. Section 14 proves lambda <= (1/4)n^(3/8) log2(n) + 2 n^(5/16) + o(n^(5/16)); the remaining positive unit gap absorbs every fixed polynomial storage factor. This bound is joint with unconditional full-secret success and all other claims.

For the same LLV-G125GP configuration, every N and s, and the same source promise, peak quantum allocation on EVERY branch is O(n) qubits, with an absolute constant and exact envelope growth index 0. This includes retained phase indices and siblings, finishing levels, each fresh U = a lambda search register, reusable oracle and reflection scratch, rank/projection registers, source transforms and extraction ancillas. Search trials reset and release their scratch. This bound holds jointly with unconditional full-secret success and the other four claims.

For the same LLV-G125GP configuration, every N and s, and the same source promise, the total number of fresh source copies acquired on EVERY branch is O(2^((1/2)sqrt(n))), with an absolute outside constant and exact growth index 1/2. Failed, rejected, discarded and aborted copies are included. Section 8 proves the literal main cap n Ccap + K <= 2^((1/2)sqrt(n)) from m H_prec <= P_prec B_src, where Dbar = 2^a K lambda a^m, Dcap = 2^12 n Dbar and Ccap = 2^13 n Dbar. The finite branch affects only the outside constant. This is joint with unconditional full-secret success and all other resource and error claims.

For this same LLV-G125GP configuration the proved fractional error tolerance is epsilon(n) = 0: every acquired source copy is an independent ideal coset state. Under that promise, for every N and s, the entire secret is recovered with unconditional probability at least 1 - 2^-8, jointly with all four resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance or impossibility of greater tolerance is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
